pipe_through_prog(prog, text):\n    p1 = Popen(prog.split(), stdout=PIPE, stdin=PIPE, stderr=PIPE)\n    [result, err] = p1.communicate(input=text.encode('utf-8'))\n    return [p1.returncode, result, commonmark\n\nA CommonMark 0.31.2 parser delivered as one executable. It reads Markdown on standard input and writes HTML on standard output.\n\n## Usage\n\n```sh\n./commonmark < document.md > document.html\nprintf '# Hello\\n' | ./commonmark\n```\n\n## Interface\n\n- **Input (stdin):** UTF-8 Markdown. Invalid UTF-8 bytes become U+FFFD. LF, CR, and CRLF are all line endings. U+0000 is replaced with U+FFFD.\n- **Output (stdout):** rendered HTML only, encoded as UTF-8.\n- **Diagnostics (stderr):** used only for internal errors.\n- **Arguments:** none. The executable takes no options.\n- **Exit status:** always 0, for any input, including empty input.\n\n## Requirements\n\nPython 3.11 or later. Do not filter, skip, or reinterpret.\n#\n# `drydock uat` runs `sh sources/full_test.sh` from the completed application root and takes its\n# exit code and output as the score. The interface check is separate from the conformance run so\n# that a missing or non-executable program and a genuine conformance failure are distinguishable\n# in the evidence. The program path is the harness's only knowledge of the implementation\n# language; the harness itself is language-neutral.\n#\n# The suite runs unfiltered: no --pattern, no --number, no selector of any kind. spec_tests.py\n# exits with failed + errored, so exit 0 means the complete CommonMark 0.31.2 suite passed.\nset -eu\n\nif [ ! -x ./commonmark ]; then\n    echo \"error: no executable ./commonmark at the application root.\" >&2\n    echo \"The deliverable is an executable named commonmark that reads UTF-8 Markdown on stdin\" >&2\n    echo \"and writes HTML to stdout.\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# spec_tests.py imports cmark and normalize as siblings, so the staged directory has to be on the\n# import path. The program is passed absolute because the runner spawns it from its own cwd.\nPYTHONPATH=\"$PWD/sources${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}\"\nexport PYTHONPATH\n\nset +e\noutput=$(python3 sources/spec_tests.py --program \"$PWD/commonmark\" --spec sources/spec.txt 2>&1)\nstatus=$?\nset -e\n\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$output\"\n\n# The runner exits with failed + errored, which a shell truncates modulo 256: exactly 256 or 512\n# failures would exit 0 and read as a pass. The harness therefore confirms the tally rather than\n# trusting the status alone, and reports a clean run only when both agree. This is the scoring\n# instrument reading its own instrument; the acceptance check above it still asserts nothing but\n# this script's exit code.\nif [ \"$status\" -ne 0 ]; then\n    exit 1\nfi\nif ! printf '%s\\n' \"$output\" | grep -q '0 failed, 0 errored, 0 skipped'; then\n    echo \"error: conformance runner exited 0 but did not report a clean unfiltered suite.\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n---\nbin:\ntotal 4\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  512 Oct 14 01:53 .\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  512 Oct 14 01:55 ..\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo 1021 Oct 14 01:53 test.sh\n\ndata:\ntotal 0\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo 512 Oct 14 01:54 .\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo 512 Oct 14 01:55 ..\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo 512 Oct 14 01:56 logs\n\nmdparser:\ntotal 4\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  512 Oct 14 01:56 .\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  512 Oct 14 01:55 ..\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  238 Oct 14 01:53 __init__.py\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  512 Oct 14 01:56 __pycache__\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  329 Oct 14 01:53 blocks.py\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo 1513 Oct 14 01:56 cli.py\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  257 Oct 14 01:53 entities.py\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  239 Oct 14 01:53 inlines.py\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  280 Oct 14 01:53 refs.py\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  239 Oct 14 01:53 render.py\n\ntests:\ntotal 12\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  512 Oct 14 01:56 .\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  512 Oct 14 01:55 ..\ndrwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  512 Oct 14 01:56 __pycache__\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo  319 Oct 14 01:53 conftest.py\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo 6860 Oct 14 01:56 test_executable.py\n-rwxrwxrwx 1 barlo barlo 3216 Oct 14 01:55 test_foundation.py","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01GHJP8B7SqVp5ZY8mw19cXE","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1crdjdUAuaxnqD2C6ah","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019ReewYerkMp5A3vUpMSeEn","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/blocks.py","content":"\"\"\"Phase 1: block tree, block-type registry, per-line procedure, and lazy continuation.\n\nResponsibility: consume lines one at a time, match them against open blocks, look for new block\nstarts, and add remaining text to the deepest open block. Link reference definitions are handed to\n`mdparser.refs` when a paragraph closes.\n\nEach block type is a `BlockType` record registered in a `BlockRegistry`. A type supplies a start\nrule, a continue rule and a close (finalize) rule; the per-line loop in `DocumentParser` never\nnames a concrete type.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nTAB_STOP = 4\nSPACE_CHARS = \" \\t\"\n\n# A start rule inspects the rest of the line below `container`. It returns a new block, after\n# advancing the cursor past its marker, or None, leaving the cursor untouched.\nStartRule = Callable[[\"Cursor\", \"Block\"], \"Block | None\"]\n# A continue rule decides whether the line continues an open block. It advances the cursor only\n# when it returns True.\nContinueRule = Callable[[\"Block\", \"Cursor\"], bool]\n# An add-line rule appends the remaining line text to a leaf block that accepts lines.\nAddLineRule = Callable[[\"Block\", \"Cursor\"], None]\n# A finalize rule runs once when a block closes, for example to set its content.\nFinalizeRule = Callable[[\"Block\"], None]\n\n\ndef next_column(char: str, col: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the column after `char`, which sits at column `col`. Tabs advance to the next tab stop.\"\"\"\n    if char == \"\\t\":\n        return col + TAB_STOP - col % TAB_STOP\n    return col + 1\n\n\ndef indent_columns(line: str, pos: int, col: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the width in columns of the spaces and tabs starting at `pos`, which sits at `col`.\"\"\"\n    end = pos\n    end_col = col\n    while end < len(line) and line[end] in SPACE_CHARS:\n        end_col = next_column(line[end], end_col)\n        end += 1\n    return end_col - col\n\n\nclass Cursor:\n    \"\"\"A position in one source line, tracked both as a character index and as a column.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, line: str) -> None:\n        self.line = line\n        self.pos = 0\n        self.col = 0\n\n    @property\n    def rest(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The text from the current position to the end of the line.\"\"\"\n        return self.line[self.pos :]\n\n    @property\n    def indent(self) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Columns of indentation from the current position to the next non-space character.\"\"\"\n        return indent_columns(self.line, self.pos, self.col)\n\n    def next_nonspace(self) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Index of the first character at or after the current position that is not a space or tab.\"\"\"\n        end = self.pos\n        while end < len(self.line) and self.line[end] in SPACE_CHARS:\n            end += 1\n        return end\n\n    def is_blank(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"True when only spaces and tabs remain on the line.\"\"\"\n        return self.next_nonspace() == len(self.line)\n\n    def advance_to(self, index: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Move the cursor forward to character `index`, tracking the column.\"\"\"\n        while self.pos < index:\n            self.col = next_column(self.line[self.pos], self.col)\n            self.pos += 1\n\n    def advance_nonspace(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Skip spaces and tabs up to the next non-space character.\"\"\"\n        self.advance_to(self.next_nonspace())\n\n    def advance_columns(self, columns: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Consume spaces and tabs until `columns` columns are passed.\n\n        A tab that straddles the target column is consumed whole, so the column may overshoot.\n        \"\"\"\n        target = self.col + columns\n        while self.pos < len(self.line) and self.col < target and self.line[self.pos] in SPACE_CHARS:\n            self.col = next_column(self.line[self.pos], self.col)\n            self.pos += 1\n\n\nclass Block:\n    \"\"\"A node in the block tree. Leaf blocks keep their raw lines; `content` is set when they close.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, kind: BlockType) -> None:\n        self.kind = kind\n        self.parent: Block | None = None\n        self.children: list[Block] = []\n        self.is_open = True\n        self.lines: list[str] = []\n        self.content = \"\"\n\n    def open_last_child(self) -> Block | None:\n        \"\"\"The last child if it is still open, otherwise None.\"\"\"\n        if self.children and self.children[-1].is_open:\n            return self.children[-1]\n        return None\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass BlockType:\n    \"\"\"The rules that define one kind of block.\n\n    `accepts_lines` marks a leaf that takes line text. `interruptible` lets a start rule close such\n    a leaf (a paragraph); a non-interruptible leaf blocks new starts. `lazy` lets a non-matching\n    line join this block as a lazy continuation. `is_container` lets the block hold child blocks.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    name: str\n    continues: ContinueRule\n    is_container: bool = False\n    accepts_lines: bool = False\n    interruptible: bool = False\n    lazy: bool = False\n    start: StartRule | None = None\n    add_line: AddLineRule | None = None\n    finalize: FinalizeRule | None = None\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if self.accepts_lines and self.add_line is None:\n            raise ValueError(f\"block type {self.name!r} accepts lines but has no add_line rule\")\n        if self.lazy and not self.accepts_lines:\n            raise ValueError(f\"block type {self.name!r} is lazy but does not accept lines\")\n\n\ndef _always_continues(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> bool:\n    return True\n\n\ndef _paragraph_continues(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> bool:\n    return not cursor.is_blank()\n\n\ndef _paragraph_add_line(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> None:\n    cursor.advance_nonspace()\n    block.lines.append(cursor.rest)\n\n\ndef _paragraph_finalize(block: Block) -> None:\n    block.content = \"\\n\".join(block.lines).strip(\" \\t\")\n\n\nDOCUMENT = BlockType(\"document\", continues=_always_continues, is_container=True)\nPARAGRAPH = BlockType(\n    \"paragraph\",\n    continues=_paragraph_continues,\n    accepts_lines=True,\n    interruptible=True,\n    lazy=True,\n    add_line=_paragraph_add_line,\n    finalize=_paragraph_finalize,\n)\n\n\nclass BlockRegistry:\n    \"\"\"The block types a parse may use: the document root, the fallback paragraph, and start rules.\n\n    Start rules are tried in registration order. The fallback type is the paragraph created when no\n    start rule matches a line of text.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, root: BlockType, fallback: BlockType) -> None:\n        self.root = root\n        self.fallback = fallback\n        self._names: set[str] = set()\n        self._starts: list[BlockType] = []\n        self.register(root)\n        self.register(fallback)\n\n    def register(self, block_type: BlockType) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Add a block type. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1cscAAW9GFDvjhFAK9R","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013RJ6SeKe35uakFC973hHD4","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/mdparser/render.py","content":"\"\"\"HTML rendering.\n\nResponsibility: turn the parsed tree into HTML, escape HTML text and attributes, and\npercent-encode URLs. The conformance runner compares normalized HTML, so tag structure and\nentities must match the spec examples.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport string\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import Block\n\nInlineParser = Callable[[str], str]\n\nESCAPES = ((\"&\", \"&amp;\"), (\"<\", \"&lt;\"), (\">\", \"&gt;\"), ('\"', \"&quot;\"))\nURL_SAFE_CHARS = frozenset(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + \";,/?:@&=+$-_.!~*'()#\")\nHEX_DIGITS = frozenset(string.hexdigits)\n\n\ndef escape_html(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Escape &, <, > and \" so the text renders as literal characters. The ampersand goes first.\"\"\"\n    for raw, entity in ESCAPES:\n        text = text.replace(raw, entity)\n    return text\n\n\ndef percent_encode_url(url: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Percent-encode a URL for use in an attribute.\n\n    URL-safe ASCII and existing %XX escapes are kept. Every other character is encoded as its\n    UTF-8 bytes, so a lone % becomes %25.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(url):\n        char = url[index]\n        if char == \"%\" and _is_hex_pair(url[index + 1 : index + 3]):\n            out.append(url[index : index + 3])\n            index += 3\n            continue\n        if char in URL_SAFE_CHARS:\n            out.append(char)\n        else:\n            out.extend(f\"%{byte:02X}\" for byte in char.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _is_hex_pair(text: str) -> bool:\n    return len(text) == 2 and all(char in HEX_DIGITS for char in text)\n\n\ndef render_document(root: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Phase 2 walk: render the top-level blocks in order, one line ending after each block.\n\n    `parse_inline` is the inline parser hook. Diagnostics go to\n`sys.stderr` only, and the exit status is 0 for every input.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport sys\n\nREPLACEMENT_CHARACTER = \"�\"\nLINE_ENDING_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n|\\r|\\n\")\n\n\ndef decode_source(data: bytes) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Decode raw input bytes as UTF-8, replacing each invalid byte with U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    return data.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n\n\ndef split_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Split text on LF, CR, or CRLF, and replace each U+0000 with U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    text = text.replace(\"\\x00\", REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER)\n    return LINE_ENDING_PATTERN.split(text)\n\n\ndef render_lines(lines: list[str]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Parse the lines and return the HTML document.\n\n    Placeholder until the block engine lands: no blocks are recognized, so the HTML is empty.\n    \"\"\"\n    return \"\"\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    \"\"\"Run the executable: stdin Markdown to stdout HTML. Always returns 0.\"\"\"\n    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()\n    try:\n        lines = split_lines(decode_source(data))\n        html = render_lines(lines)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"commonmark: internal error: {exc!r}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        html = \"\"\n    sys.stdout.buffer.write(html.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":8,"oldLines":6,"newStart":8,"newLines":8,"lines":[" import re"," import sys"," ","+from mdparser import blocks, inlines, render","+"," REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER = \"�\""," LINE_ENDING_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n|\\r|\\n\")"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_015gHgV6tfjAmBt1Y88bpTcu","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

No test matches on stderr text.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport io\nimport os\nimport subprocess\nimport types\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import cli\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: bytes) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data,\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Executable.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_executable_empty_input(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC-001: empty stdin gives empty stdout and exit status 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=\"\",\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert len(result.stdout) == 0\n\n\ndef test_executable_invalid_utf8(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC-002: invalid UTF-8 bytes are decoded with replacement and the program exits 0.\"\"\"\n    payload = b\"\\xff\\xfe text \\xc3\\x28 end\\n\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, payload)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_executable_stdout_is_html_only(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC-003: a normal run exits 0 and its stdout is valid UTF-8 text.\"\"\"\n    source = \"hello world\\n\\nsecond paragraph\\n\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, source.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_executable_line_endings(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"LF, CR and CRLF line endings yield identical output for the same document.\"\"\"\n    lines = \"one\", \"two\", \"\", \"three\"\n    variants = [\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", \"\\r\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\r\\n\", \"\\r\".join(lines) + \"\\r\"]\n    outputs = []\n    for source in variants:\n        result = run_executable(project_root, source.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        assert result.returncode == 0\n        outputs.append(result.stdout)\n    assert outputs[0] == outputs[1] == outputs[2]\n\n\ndef test_executable_nul_replacement(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"U+0000 on input is treated exactly like U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    with_nul = \"a\\x00b\\n\"\n    with_replacement = \"a�b\\n\"\n    first = run_executable(project_root, with_nul.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    second = run_executable(project_root, with_replacement.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    assert first.returncode == 0\n    assert second.returncode == 0\n    assert first.stdout == second.stdout\n\n\n# --- Executable file ---\n\n\ndef test_executable_file_has_execute_bit(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert os.access(project_root / \"commonmark\", os.X_OK)\n\n\ndef test_executable_file_has_python3_shebang(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    first_line = (project_root / \"commonmark\").read_bytes().splitlines()[0]\n    assert first_line == b\"#!/usr/bin/env python3\"\n\n\ndef test_executable_runs_from_another_working_directory(project_root: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=b\"text\\n\",\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=tmp_path,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout == b\"\"\n\n\n# --- Decoding ---\n\n\ndef test_decode_source_keeps_valid_utf8() -> None:\n    assert cli.decode_source(\"café ✓\".encode(\"utf-8\")) == \"café ✓\"\n\n\ndef test_decode_source_replaces_invalid_bytes() -> None:\n    assert cli.decode_source(b\"\\xff\") == \"�\"\n\n\ndef test_decode_source_replaces_truncated_sequence_without_eating_next_byte() -> None:\n    assert cli.decode_source(b\"\\xc3\\x28\") == \"�(\"\n\n\ndef test_decode_source_empty_bytes_gives_empty_text() capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Executable.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_executable_empty_input(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC-001: empty stdin gives empty stdout and exit status 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / payload = b\"\\xff\\xfe text \\xc3\\x28 end\\n\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, payload)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_executable_stdout_is_html_only(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC-003: a normal run exits 0 and its stdout is valid UTF-8 text.\"\"\"\n    source = \"hello world\\n\\nsecond paragraph\\n\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, source.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_executable_line_endings(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"LF, CR and CRLF line endings yield identical output for the same document.\"\"\"\n    lines = \"one\", \"two\", \"\", \"three\"\n    variants = [\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", \"\\r\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\r\\n\", \"\\r\".join(lines) + \"\\r\"]\n    outputs = []\n    for source in variants:\n        result = run_executable(project_root, source.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        assert result.returncode == 0\n        outputs.append(result.stdout)\n    assert outputs[0] == outputs[1] == outputs[2]\n\n\ndef test_executable_nul_replacement(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"U+0000 on input is treated exactly like U+FFFD.\"\"\"\n    with_nul = \"a\\x00b\\n\"\n    with_replacement = \"a�b\\n\"\n    first = run_executable(project_root, with_nul.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    second = run_executable(project_root, with_replacement.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n    assert first.returncode == 0\n    assert second.returncode == 0\n    assert first.stdout == second.stdout\n\n\n# --- Executable file ---\n\n\ndef test_executable_file_has_execute_bit(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout == b\"<p>text</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- Decoding ---\n\n\ndef test_decode_source_keeps_valid_utf8() -> None:\n    assert cli.decode_source(\"café DOCUMENT,\n    PARAGRAPH,\n    Block,\n    BlockRegistry,\n    BlockType,\n    Cursor,\n    DocumentParser,\n    indent_columns,\n    next_column,\n    parse_lines,\n)\n\n\ndef kinds(block: Block) -> 0, 0) == 4\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_pads_a_tab_after_spaces_to_the_tab_stop() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"  \\tx\", 0, 0) == 4\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_counts_two_tabs_as_eight() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\t\\tx\", 0, 0) == 8\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_is_zero_without_leading_whitespace() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"x  \", 0, 0) == 0\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_starts_from_the_given_column() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\tx\", 0, 2) == 2\n\n\n# --- Cursor ---\n\n\ndef test_cursor_rest_starts_as_the_whole_line() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"abc\").rest == \"abc\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_is_blank_for_empty_and_whitespace_lines() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"\").is_blank()\n    assert Cursor(\" \\t \").is_blank()\n\n\ndef test_cursor_is_not_blank_with_text() -> None:\n    assert not Cursor(\"  a\").is_blank()\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_nonspace_tracks_column_across_a_tab() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"  \\t x\")\n    cursor.advance_nonspace()\n    assert cursor.pos == 4\n    assert cursor.col == 5\n    assert cursor.rest == \"x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_columns_consumes_whole_tab_when_it_overshoots() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"\\tx\")\n    cursor.advance_columns(2)\n    assert cursor.pos == 1\n    assert cursor.col == 4\n    assert cursor.rest == \"x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_columns_stops_at_the_target_column() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"    x\")\n    cursor.advance_columns(2)\n    assert cursor.rest == \"  x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_indent_reports_columns_to_next_text() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"\\t\\tx\").indent == 8\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_to_moves_by_characters() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"abc\")\n    cursor.advance_to(2)\n    assert cursor.rest == \"c\"\n\n\n# --- Empty and blank input ---\n\n\ndef test_empty_input_gives_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([]).children == []\n\n\ndef test_one_empty_line_gives_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([\"\"]).children == []\n\n\ndef test_blank_lines_only_give_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([\"\", \"  \", test_paragraph_is_closed_by_a_blank_line_before_the_next_one() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"one\", \"\", \"two\"])\n    assert [child.is_open for child in root.children] == [False, False]\n\n\ndef test_document_root_is_a_container_with_no_content() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"a\"])\n    assert root.kind is DOCUMENT\n    assert root.content == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_raw_lines_are_recorded_as_read() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"one\", \"   two\"])\n    assert root.children[0].lines == [\"one\", \"two\"]\n\n\ndef test_parsing_the_same_lines_twice_gives_the_same_tree() -> None:\n    lines = [\"a\", \"\", \"b\", \"c\"]\n    first = [(kind, content) for kind, content in _shape(parse_lines(lines))]\n    second = [(kind, content) for kind, content in _shape(parse_lines(lines))]\n    assert first == second\n\n\ndef _shape(root: Block) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return [(child.kind.name, child.content) for child in root.children]\n\n\n# --- Registry ---\n\n\ndef test_registry_rejects_a_duplicate_block_type_name() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        registry.register(PARAGRAPH)\n\n\ndef test_default_registry_has_no_start_rules_yet() -> None:\n    assert blocks.DEFAULT_REGISTRY.starts() == ()\n\n\ndef test_lazy_block_type_must_accept_lines() -> None:\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        BlockType(\"bad\", continues=lambda block, cursor: True, lazy=True)\n\n\ndef test_leaf_block_type_must_have_an_add_line_rule() -> None:\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        BlockType(\"bad\", continues=lambda block, cursor: True, accepts_lines=True)\n\n\n# --- Extensibility: block types registered without changing the loop ---\n\n\ndef _rule_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    if cursor.rest.strip(\" \\t\") == \"***\":\n        cursor.advance_to(len(cursor.line))\n        return Block(RULE)\n    return None\n\n\nRULE = BlockType(\"rule\", continues=lambda block, cursor: False, start=_rule_start)\n\n\ndef test_registered_start_rule_interrupts_a_paragraph() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"a\", \"***\", \"b\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\", \"rule\", \"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"a\", \"b\"]\n\n\ndef test_registered_start_rule_closes_an_unmatched_block_before_it_starts() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"***\", \"b\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"rule\", \"paragraph\"]\n    assert root.children[0].is_open is False\n\n\ndef test_start_rule_is_not_tried_inside_a_non_interruptible_leaf() -> None:\n    raw_lines_type = BlockType(\n        \"raw\",\n        continues=lambda block, cursor: True,\n        accepts_lines=True,\n        add_line=lambda block, cursor: block.lines.append(cursor.rest),\n    )\n\n    def raw_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n        if cursor.rest.startswith(\"<<\"):\n            cursor.advance_to(len(cursor.line))\n            return Block(raw_lines_type)\n        return None\n\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(BlockType(\"raw_start\", continues=lambda block, cursor: False, start=raw_start))\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"<<\", \"***\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"raw_start\"] or kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\"] or True\n    raw = [child for child in root.children if child.kind is raw_lines_type]\n    assert len(raw) == 1\n    assert raw[0].lines[-1] == \"***\"\n    assert [child for child in root.children if child.kind is RULE] == []\n\n\n# --- Lazy paragraph continuation, via a test-only container ---\n\n\ndef _quote_continues(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> bool:\n    index = cursor.next_nonspace()\n    if cursor.line[index : index + 1] == \">\":\n        cursor.advance_to(index + 1)\n        return True\n    return False\n\n\ndef _quote_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    index = cursor.next_nonspace()\n    if cursor.line[index : index + 1] == \">\":\n        cursor.advance_to(index + 1)\n        return Block(QUOTE)\n    return None\n\n\nQUOTE = BlockType(\"quote\", continues=_quote_continues, is_container=True, start=_quote_start)\n\n\ndef quote_registry() -> BlockRegistry:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(QUOTE)\n    return registry\n\n\ndef test_quote_holds_its_paragraph() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"> a\", \"> b\"], quote_registry())\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"quote\"]\n    assert kinds(root.children[0]) == [\"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root.children[0]) == [\"a\\nb\"]\n\n\ndef test_unmarked_line_is_a_lazy_continuation_of_the_quote_paragraph() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"> a\", \"b\"], quote_registry())\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"quote\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root.children[0]) == [\"a\\nb\"]\n\n\ndef test_blank_line_ends_the_lazy_continuation() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"> a\", \"\", \"b\"], quote_registry())\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"quote\", \"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root.children[0]) == [\"a\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"b\"]\n\n\ndef test_document_parser_can_be_driven_one_line_at_a_time() -> None:\n    parser = DocumentParser(quote_registry())\n    parser.incorporate_line(\"> a\")\n    assert {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1cv8uuYkFTohKnPdY9U","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01L74LBra9ThZR9fyDmSa2Vg","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/tests/test_blocks.py","old_string":"def test_start_rule_is_not_tried_inside_a_non_interruptible_leaf() -> None:\n    raw_lines_type = BlockType(\n        \"raw\",\n        continues=lambda block, cursor: True,\n        accepts_lines=True,\n        add_line=lambda block, cursor: block.lines.append(cursor.rest),\n    )\n\n    def raw_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n        if cursor.rest.startswith(\"<<\"):\n cursor.advance_to(2)\n    assert cursor.rest == \"c\"\n\n\n# --- Empty and blank input ---\n\n\ndef test_empty_input_gives_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([]).children == []\n\n\ndef None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\t\\tx\", 0, 0) == 8\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_is_zero_without_leading_whitespace() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"x  \", 0, 0) == 0\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_starts_from_the_given_column() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\tx\", 0, 2) == 2\n\n\n# --- Cursor ---\n\n\ndef test_cursor_rest_starts_as_the_whole_line() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"abc\").rest == \"abc\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_is_blank_for_empty_and_whitespace_lines() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"\").is_blank()\n    assert Cursor(\" \\t \").is_blank()\n\n\ndef cursor.advance_to(2)\n    assert cursor.rest == \"c\"\n\n\n# --- Empty and blank input ---\n\n\ndef test_empty_input_gives_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([]).children == []\n\n\ndef \"&amp;amp;\"\n\n\n# --- URL percent-encoding ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"url\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"\", \"\"),\n        (\"abc\", \"abc\"),\n        (\"a b\", \"a%20b\"),\n        (\"é\", \"%C3%A9\"),\n        (\"😀\", \"%F0%9F%98%80\"),\n        (\"%20\", \"%20\"),\n        (\"%zz\", \"%25zz\"),\n        (\"%\", \"%25\"),\n        (\"a\\\"b\", \"a%22b\"),\n        (\"[x]\", \"%5Bx%5D\"),\n        (\"http://e.com/a?b=c&d=#e\", \"http://e.com/a?b=c&d=#e\"),\n        (\"a\\\\b\", \"a%5Cb\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_percent_encode_url_encodes_only_what_must_be_encoded(url: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert render.percent_encode_url(url) == expected\n\n\ndef test_percent_encode_url_is_idempotent() -> \"<p>alpha</p>\\n<p>beta</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_content_is_escaped_by_the_default_hook() -> None:\n    assert render_source([\"x < y > z & w\"]) == \"<p>x &lt; y &gt; z &amp; w</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_phase_two_calls_the_hook_with_each_paragraphs_raw_content() -> None:\n    calls: list[str] = []\n\n    def recording_hook(raw: str) -> str:\n        calls.append(raw)\n        return raw\n\n    render_source([\"one\", \"two\", \"\", \"three\"], recording_hook)\n    assert calls == [\"one\\ntwo\", \"three\"]\n\n\ndef test_phase_two_places_the_hook_output_inside_the_paragraph() -> None:\n    assert render_source([\"abc\"], upper_hook) == \"<p>ABC</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_block_without_a_renderer_is_rejected() -> Each test compares a returned string with its exact expected value.\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import blocks, inlines, render\nfrom mdparser.blocks import DOCUMENT, PARAGRAPH, Block, BlockRegistry, BlockType\n\n\ndef upper_hook(raw: str) -> str:\n    return raw.upper()\n\n\ndef render_source(lines: list[str], hook=inlines.parse_inline) -> str:\n    return render.render_document(blocks.parse_lines(lines), hook)\n\n\n# --- HTML escaping ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"text\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"&\", \"&amp;\"),\n        (\"<\", \"&lt;\"),\n        (\">\", \"&gt;\"),\n        ('\"', \"&quot;\"),\n        (\"'\", \"'\"),\n        (\"plain\", \"plain\"),\n        (\"\", \"\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_escape_html_maps_each_special_character(text: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert render.escape_html(text) == expected\n\n\ndef test_escape_html_does_not_escape_an_ampersand_twice() -> None:\n    assert render.escape_html(\"<&>\") == \"&lt;&amp;&gt;\"\n\n\ndef test_escape_html_leaves_existing_entity_text_as_an_escaped_ampersand() -> None:\n    assert render.escape_html(\"&amp;\") == \"&amp;amp;\"\n\n\n# --- URL percent-encoding ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"url\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"\", \"\"),\n        (\"abc\", \"abc\"),\n        (\"a b\", \"a%20b\"),\n        (\"é\", \"%C3%A9\"),\n        (\"😀\", \"%F0%9F%98%80\"),\n        (\"%20\", \"%20\"),\n        (\"%zz\", \"%25zz\"),\n        (\"%\", \"%25\"),\n        (\"a\\\"b\", \"a%22b\"),\n        (\"[x]\", \"%5Bx%5D\"),\n        (\"http://e.com/a?b=c&d=#e\", \"http://e.com/a?b=c&d=#e\"),\n        (\"a\\\\b\", \"a%5Cb\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_percent_encode_url_encodes_only_what_must_be_encoded(url: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    assert render.percent_encode_url(url) == expected\n\n\ndef test_percent_encode_url_is_idempotent() -> None:\n    once = render.percent_encode_url(\"a b é%zz\")\n    assert render.percent_encode_url(once) == once\n\n\n# --- Phase 2 walk and paragraph rendering ---\n\n\ndef test_empty_document_renders_nothing() -> None:\n    assert render.render_document(Block(DOCUMENT), upper_hook) == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_one_paragraph_renders_as_one_p_element_with_a_line_ending() -> None:\n    assert render_source([\"alpha\"]) == \"<p>alpha</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_each_paragraph_renders_with_its_own_line_ending() -> None:\n    assert render_source([\"alpha\", \"\", \"beta\"]) == \"<p>alpha</p>\\n<p>beta</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_content_is_escaped_by_the_default_hook() -> None:\n    assert render_source([\"x < y > z & w\"]) == \"<p>x &lt; y &gt; z &amp; w</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_phase_two_calls_the_hook_with_each_paragraphs_raw_content() -> None:\n    calls: list[str] = []\n\n    def recording_hook(raw: str) -> str:\n        calls.append(raw)\n        return raw\n\n    render_source([\"one\", \"two\", \"\", \"three\"], recording_hook)\n    assert calls == [\"one\\ntwo\", \"three\"]\n\n\ndef test_phase_two_places_the_hook_output_inside_the_paragraph() -> None:\n    assert render_source([\"abc\"], upper_hook) == \"<p>ABC</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_block_without_a_renderer_is_rejected() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    unknown = BlockType(\"unknown\", continues=lambda block, cursor: False, is_container=False)\n    registry.register(unknown)\n    root = Block(DOCUMENT)\n    root.children.append(Block(unknown))\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        render.render_document(root, upper_hook)\n\n\n# --- Inline parser hook ---\n\n\ndef test_inline_hook_escapes_special_characters() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"a<b>&\\\"c\\\"\") == \"a&lt;b&gt;&amp;&quot;c&quot;\"\n\n\ndef test_inline_hook_returns_empty_text_for_empty_content() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\") == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_inline_hook_keeps_ordinary_text_unchanged() -> None:\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"plain words, 123\") == \"plain words, 123\"\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01R9tKRYP2zGtrJPiHf9rtTA","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1cwKh5KErPnP644Lfoy","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01X3fbf2VySqevC5fZda9Rqb","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/tests/test_block_engine.py","content":"\"\"\"Block-engine acceptance and end-to-end tests: paragraphs, blank lines, and HTML escaping through\nthe `commonmark` executable.\n\nThe four declared checks from FEATURE-Block-Engine.md are transcribed first, with their\nassertions unchanged. The remaining tests compare the exact stdout bytes, which is the state\nthe executable hands back.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef run_commonmark(project_root: Path, source: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=source,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Block-Engine.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_engine_paragraph_count(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Blank-line-separated paragraphs render as one p element each.\"\"\"\n    paragraphs = [\"alpha beta\", \"gamma delta\", \"epsilon\"]\n    source = \"\\n\\n\".join(paragraphs) + \"\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == len(paragraphs)\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"</p>\") == len(paragraphs)\n    for text in paragraphs:\n        assert text in result.stdout\n\n\ndef test_engine_multiline_paragraph(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Consecutive non-blank lines with arbitrary indentation after the first stay in one paragraph.\"\"\"\n    first = \"first line\"\n    second = \"second line\"\n    third = \"third line\"\n    source = first + \"\\n\" + \"             \" + second + \"\\n\" + third + \"\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n    for text in (first, second, third):\n        assert text in result.stdout\n\n\ndef test_engine_blank_lines_ignored(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Leading, trailing and repeated blank lines add no blocks; a blank-only document gives no paragraph.\"\"\"\n    word = \"content\"\n    padded = \"\\n  \\n\\n\" + word + \"\\n\\n\\n  \\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, padded)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n    blank = run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n \\n\\t\\n\")\n    assert blank.returncode == 0\n    assert blank.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_engine_html_escaping(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Special characters in paragraph text are escaped, so only the paragraph tags contribute angle brackets.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"x < y > z & w\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<\") == 2\n    assert result.stdout.count(\">\") == 2\n\n\n# --- Exact output through the executable ---\n\n\ndef test_single_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert run_commonmark(project_root, \"hello world\\n\").stdout == \"<p>hello world</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_two_paragraphs_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\n\\ntwo\\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>one</p>\\n<p>two</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_multiline_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    source = \"first line\\n             second line\\nthird line\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>first line\\nsecond line\\nthird line</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"x < y > z & w\\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>x &lt; y &gt; z &amp; w</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_padded_document_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n  \\n\\ncontent\\n\\n\\n  \\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>content</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_blank_only_document_output_is_empty(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n \\n\\t\\n\").stdout == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_is_removed(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"   \\tword \\t  \\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>word</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_crlf_document_renders_the_same_as_lf(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    lf = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\ntwo\\n\\nthree\\n\")\n    crlf = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\r\\ntwo\\r\\n\\r\\nthree\\r\\n\")\n    assert lf.stdout == crlf.stdout == \"<p>one\\ntwo</p>\\n<p>three</p>\\n\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2062,"cache_read_input_tokens":89347,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2062},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"eef05da2-204c-4696-93f7-93b540dcbbe1","uuid":"f0d91b5a-7102-495e-a0ea-19739d03436c","timestamp":"2026-10-14T06:01:15.471Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1cwKRwvAqD4kiCKAnLk","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01X3fbf2VySqevC5fZda9Rqb":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/tests/test_block_engine.py","content":"\"\"\"Block-engine acceptance and end-to-end tests: paragraphs, blank lines, and HTML escaping through\nthe `commonmark` executable.\n\nThe four declared checks from FEATURE-Block-Engine.md are transcribed first, with their\nassertions unchanged. The remaining tests compare the exact stdout bytes, which is the state\nthe executable hands back.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef run_commonmark(project_root: Path, source: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=source,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Block-Engine.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_engine_paragraph_count(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Blank-line-separated paragraphs render as one p element each.\"\"\"\n    paragraphs = [\"alpha beta\", \"gamma delta\", \"epsilon\"]\n    source = \"\\n\\n\".join(paragraphs) + \"\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == len(paragraphs)\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"</p>\") == len(paragraphs)\n    for text in paragraphs:\n        assert text in result.stdout\n\n\ndef test_engine_multiline_paragraph(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Consecutive non-blank lines with arbitrary indentation after the first stay in one paragraph.\"\"\"\n    first = \"first line\"\n    second = \"second line\"\n    third = \"third line\"\n    source = first + \"\\n\" + \"             \" + second + \"\\n\" + third + \"\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n    for text in (first, second, third):\n        assert text in result.stdout\n\n\ndef test_engine_blank_lines_ignored(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Leading, trailing and repeated blank lines add no blocks; a blank-only document gives no paragraph.\"\"\"\n    word = \"content\"\n    padded = \"\\n  \\n\\n\" + word + \"\\n\\n\\n  \\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, padded)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n    blank = run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n \\n\\t\\n\")\n    assert blank.returncode == 0\n    assert blank.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_engine_html_escaping(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Special characters in paragraph text are escaped, so only the paragraph tags contribute angle brackets.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"x < y > z & w\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<\") == 2\n    assert result.stdout.count(\">\") == 2\n\n\n# --- Exact output through the executable ---\n\n\ndef test_single_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert run_commonmark(project_root, \"hello world\\n\").stdout == \"<p>hello world</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_two_paragraphs_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\n\\ntwo\\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>one</p>\\n<p>two</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_multiline_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    source = \"first line\\n             second line\\nthird line\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>first line\\nsecond line\\nthird line</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"x < y > z & w\\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>x &lt; y &gt; z &amp; w</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_padded_document_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n  \\n\\ncontent\\n\\n\\n  \\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>content</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_blank_only_document_output_is_empty(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n \\n\\t\\n\").stdout == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_is_removed(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"   \\tword \\t  \\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>word</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_crlf_document_renders_the_same_as_lf(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    lf = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\ntwo\\n\\nthree\\n\")\n    crlf = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\r\\ntwo\\r\\n\\r\\nthree\\r\\n\")\n    assert lf.stdout == crlf.stdout == \"<p>one\\ntwo</p>\\n<p>three</p>\\n\"\n"}}}

The remaining tests compare the exact stdout bytes, which is the state\nthe executable hands back.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef run_commonmark(project_root: Path, source: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=source,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Block-Engine.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_engine_paragraph_count(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Blank-line-separated paragraphs render as one p element each.\"\"\"\n    paragraphs = [\"alpha beta\", \"gamma delta\", \"epsilon\"]\n    source = \"\\n\\n\".join(paragraphs) + \"\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == len(paragraphs)\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"</p>\") == len(paragraphs)\n    for text in paragraphs:\n        assert text in result.stdout\n\n\ndef test_engine_multiline_paragraph(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Consecutive non-blank lines with arbitrary indentation after the first stay in one paragraph.\"\"\"\n    first = \"first line\"\n    second = \"second line\"\n    third = \"third line\"\n    source = first + \"\\n\" + \"             \" + second + \"\\n\" + third + \"\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n    for text in (first, second, third):\n        assert text in result.stdout\n\n\ndef test_engine_blank_lines_ignored(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Leading, trailing and repeated blank lines add no blocks; a blank-only document gives no paragraph.\"\"\"\n    word = \"content\"\n    padded = \"\\n  \\n\\n\" + word + \"\\n\\n\\n  \\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, padded)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n    blank = run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n \\n\\t\\n\")\n    assert blank.returncode == 0\n    assert blank.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_engine_html_escaping(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Special characters in paragraph text are escaped, so only the paragraph tags contribute angle brackets.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"x < y > z & w\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<\") == 2\n    assert result.stdout.count(\">\") == 2\n\n\n# --- Exact output through the executable ---\n\n\ndef test_single_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert run_commonmark(project_root, \"hello world\\n\").stdout == \"<p>hello world</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_two_paragraphs_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\n\\ntwo\\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>one</p>\\n<p>two</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_multiline_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    source = \"first line\\n             second line\\nthird line\\n\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>first line\\nsecond line\\nthird line</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_paragraph_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"x < y > z & w\\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>x &lt; y &gt; z &amp; w</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_padded_document_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n  \\n\\ncontent\\n\\n\\n  \\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>content</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_blank_only_document_output_is_empty(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    assert run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n \\n\\t\\n\").stdout == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_is_removed(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"   \\tword \\t  \\n\")\n    assert result.stdout == \"<p>word</p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_crlf_document_renders_the_same_as_lf(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    lf = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\ntwo\\n\\nthree\\n\")\n    crlf = run_commonmark(project_root, \"one\\r\\ntwo\\r\\n\\r\\nthree\\r\\n\")\n    assert lf.stdout == crlf.stdout == \"<p>one\\ntwo</p>\\n<p>three</p>\\n\"\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01X3fbf2VySqevC5fZda9Rqb","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}
